answer_1.quote: We have explored this reward for a new family of Actor-Critic Transformer-based Architectures with synchronous and asynchronous variants that promote the exploration of the search space.
answer_1.outputs: Generated translations in English from German source sentences

answer_2.quote: We used the standard set of MT evaluation metrics: BLEU and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: Finally, to gain deeper insights, we performed human evaluation on the translations of the OpenSubtitles and IWSLT 2014 test sets by the Transformer, Async-ACQ-BLEU and the best performing SURF variants (A3C for OpenSubtitles and Async-ACQ for IWSLT).
answer_4.guideline: A rank of quality is assigned by the human evaluator from 1 to 3, allowing ties. Following the common practice in MT, each system was then assigned a score which reflects how often on average it was judged to be better or equal to other systems.
